body:
Every cursor-movement/delete function in editor/buffer.prn moved exactly one byte, not one UTF-8 codepoint, corrupting multi-byte characters. Fixed via utf8-codepoint-len/utf8-prev-boundary helpers. New test_editor_unicode.c exercises a real 2-byte and 4-byte codepoint, not just ASCII. make test 345/345, make test-editor (real SDL) also green. Commit ee7e3cd.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed real UTF-8 bug in PARENA editor (kanban 3454353)
